# Joseph Obeys the Dream (Luke 2:4)

## Emotional Focus
Obeying God’s direction even in hard times.

## Key KJV
“And Joseph also went up from Galilee… to be taxed with Mary his espoused wife.” (Luke 2:4)

## Gentle Retelling
An angel told Joseph in a dream to take Mary and baby Jesus to Egypt. Joseph obeyed right away and kept them safe.

## Coloring Prompt
Joseph leading a donkey with Mary and baby Jesus on a quiet path to Egypt.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God’s direction keeps us safe when we obey quickly.”
